caveat: Computed by the real metrics pipeline, but from the synthetic scaffold table, not from store footage. Structure is real; the numbers are not.

data.headline: Your busiest hour
data.detail: 232 shoppers walked in during this hour alone. Put your staff on the floor against this curve rather than against habit — the rush is usually later in the day than it feels.

data.headline: Trials holds them longest
data.detail: That is how long a shopper gives this one section before moving on. Put your most knowledgeable staff near Trials — people are already spending attention there, and that is where a question turns into a sale.

data.headline: Kids had nobody serving
data.detail: Shoppers stood in Kids with no staff nearby for that long, out of about 10.6 hours when anybody was in there at all. The longest single gap was 10 minutes. Most of it is staff being pulled to the till.
